item.title: About me
item.description:
I am currently an undergraduate student at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT), with research interests in signal processing, optimization, and statistics.

I will begin my master’s studies in Computer Science and Technology at ShanghaiTech University in the autumn semester of 2026, under the supervision of Prof. Ziping Zhao, whose research focuses on optimization and signal processing.

From June 2024 to June 2025, I was a visiting student in the group of Prof. Junjie Ma at the Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science(AMSS). During this period, I conducted research related to sampling and diffusion models. It is a great honor to explore everything in the academic world under the guidance of Prof. Ma!

I am eager to pursue engaging theoretical research driven by my curiosity and passion, with the aim of deepening my understanding and exploration of the world.

You can find my CV here: Haitong Lan’s Curriculum Vitae.

If you want to chat with me or have any questions, please feel free to contact me!
